2585-5660-6769-8095.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-5660-6769-8095.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Grim Monolith, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

789-883-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:

789-883-4279--216.description:

When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.

The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 3.
